message.content: {"skills": [{"slot": 1, "name": "FormRequest 表单提交构造", "description": "使用 FormRequest 构造带 formdata 的 POST 请求，并绑定 callback 处理响应，用于向表单端点提交数据。", "asset_type": "micro_skill", "asset_node_id": "micro_skill_node", "granularity": "micro", "objective": "构造并发送携带表单数据的 POST 请求", "domain": "scrapy", "task_family": "请求构造", "method_family": "FormRequest", "stage": "请求生成", "use_when": ["需要向表单 action 端点提交字段数据", "需要以 POST 方式发送结构化表单"], "do_not_use_when": ["目标端点不接受表单编码", "仅需 GET 抓取静态页面"], "success_artifact": "返回一个带 formdata 与 callback 的 FormRequest 对象列表", "why_distinct": "聚焦单一表单 POST 构造动作，区别于登录模拟与响应处理。", "evidence_span_hint": "FormRequest(url=..., formdata={...}, callback=self.after_post)", "confidence": 0.85}, {"slot": 2, "name": "FormRequest.from_response 登录模拟", "description": "用 FormRequest.from_response() 自动预填隐藏表单字段（如会话数据、认证令牌），仅覆盖用户名密码等少数字段以模拟登录。", "asset_type": "micro_skill", "asset_node_id": "micro_skill_node", "granularity": "micro", "objective": "基于已有响应表单自动预填并覆盖关键字段完成登录提交", "domain": "scrapy", "task_family": "登录模拟", "method_family": "FormRequest.from_response", "stage": "会话建立", "use_when": ["登录页含 input type=hidden 的令牌或会话字段", "需要保留预填字段仅覆盖用户名密码"], "do_not_use_when": ["目标页面无表单或无需认证", "需要完全手工构造全部字段"], "success_artifact": "生成一个继承隐藏字段并覆盖指定字段的登录 FormRequest", "why_distinct": "依赖已有响应表单做预填，与从零构造 formdata 的提交动作不同。", "evidence_span_hint": "Using FormRequest.from_response() to simulate a user login", "confidence": 0.85}]}
